title: occupant — jolt

sentences.sentence: The furniture had been left by the previous occupants.
sentences.translation: 家具是先前的住户留下的。

sentences.sentence: This approach is too inflexible and too costly.
sentences.translation: 这个方法太死板，而且花费也太高。

sentences.sentence: The soul unfolds itself, like a lotus of countless petals.
sentences.translation: 灵魂伸展绽放，就像一朵有无数花瓣的莲花。

sentences.sentence: For me, the lotus and blue cedar dominate, but they work well together.
sentences.translation: 她的芬香以莲花和蓝色雪松为主，几种香味完美融合。

sentences.sentence: inexplicable behaviour
sentences.translation: 费解的行为

sentences.sentence: For some inexplicable reason, he felt depressed.
sentences.translation: 他无端地感到很沮丧。

sentences.sentence: It was nineteen minutes past seven.
sentences.translation: 当时是7点19分。

sentences.sentence: I was only nineteen (= 19 years old ).
sentences.translation: 我当时只有19岁。

translations.translation: 治疗的, 治疗学的 n治疗剂, 治疗学家

sentences.sentence: Some claim that the herb has therapeutic value for treating pain.
sentences.translation: 有些人称这种草药具有止痛的疗效。

sentences.sentence: Many members thought the rules were too restrictive.
sentences.translation: 很多会员认为这些规定限制条件太多。

sentences.sentence: a restrictive policy on admission to the college
sentences.translation: 大学入学的限制性政策

sentences.sentence: A full-scale debate is under way on what ails the industry.
sentences.translation: 就困扰工业发展的弊端所展开的一次全面讨论正在进行中。

sentences.sentence: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
sentences.translation: 她解开头绳，让头发在风里自由地飘。

translations.translation: 希腊的, 希腊式的 n希腊学家

sentences.sentence: a Grecian urn
sentences.translation: 希腊古瓮

phrases.translation: 卫护信仰者；信仰护卫者

sentences.sentence: He presented himself as a defender of democracy.
sentences.translation: 他以民主捍卫者的姿态出现。

sentences.sentence: His study of eruptions over the past 300 years with Ben Mason of the University of Cambridge and colleagues reveals that volcanism varies with the seasons.
sentences.translation: 他和剑桥大学的本.梅森及其同事研究了过去300年来发生的火山喷发，研究显示火山活动随季节变化而不同。

sentences.sentence: Both kinds of plate boundary are associated with fault systems, earthquakes and volcanism, but the kinds of geologic activity observed at the two boundaries are quite different.
sentences.translation: 两种板块边界均与地层系统、地震以及火山活动有关，但在两种边界处观察到的诸般地质活动 却迥然不同。

translations.translation: [地]潜没(指地壳的板块沉到另一板块之下)

sentences.sentence: In the past 300 years, no earthquake nearly that large — nothing larger than magnitude-eight — had struck in the Japan subduction zone.
sentences.translation: 在过去的300年里，在日本俯冲地区，从没发生过一个如此巨大的地震-没有一次比八级还大。

sentences.sentence: The two species diverged millions of years ago.
sentences.translation: 这两个物种从数百万年前开始朝不同方向演变。

sentences.sentence: Global growth rates are diverging markedly.
sentences.translation: 世界各地的增长率在发生明显的分化。

sentences.sentence: A disposable electrocardiogram machine the size of a Band-Aid monitors a heart patient.
sentences.translation: 一个邦迪大小的一次性心电图仪器监视着一个心脏病人。

sentences.sentence: Some countries, such as Italy and Japan, screen young people with the use of an electrocardiogram (ECG, or EKG), which records the electrical signals present in the heart.
sentences.translation: 一些其他的国家，比如意大利和日本，人们用心电图（ECG或EKG）给年轻人做检查，心电图记录了心脏发出的电信号。

sentences.sentence: With his left hand he groped for the knob, turned it, and pulled the door open.
sentences.translation: 他用左手摸索到门把手，转动把手，把门拉开。

sentences.sentence: Some parents hesitate to take these steps because they suspect that their child is exaggerating.
sentences.translation: 一些家长迟迟不肯采取这些措施，因为他们怀疑自己的孩子在夸大其词。

sentences.sentence: The brain, too, sends out brain waves of electricity, which can be recorded in an electroencephalogram.
sentences.translation: 大脑也是一样，会发出脑电波，而脑电波可以在脑电图中记录。

sentences.sentence: The researchers tracked various bits of data about a dreamer, like rapid eye movement electroencephalogram (EEG) readings. They then fed this data into the robot.
sentences.translation: 研究人员跟踪有关睡梦者的各种数据位，如快速眼动脑电图描记器读数，然后把这些数据输入机器人。

sentences.sentence: He found that the number of pulses, known as sleep spindles, generated by this organ and measured by an electroencephalogram, which records electrical activity in the brain, varied among the sleepers.
sentences.translation: 他通过一种用于记录大脑电活动的脑电图设备测量了丘脑产生的脑电脉冲； 并且他发现，这个器官产生的脑电脉冲——也被称为睡眠纺锤波——的数量在不同志愿者身上存在差异。

sentences.sentence: ...blackout curtains.
sentences.translation: …灯火管制时用的窗帘。

sentences.sentence: We jolted along rough wet roads through an endless banana plantation.
sentences.translation: 我们沿崎岖潮湿的公路颠簸着驶过无边无际的香蕉种植园。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 443 单元

occupant
音标：英 /'ɒkjʊp(ə)nt/  美 /'ɑkəpənt/
n. 占有者, 居住者
例句：The furniture had been left by the previous occupants.
家具是先前的住户留下的。

inflexible
音标：英 /ɪn'fleksɪb(ə)l/  美 /ɪn'flɛksəbl/
adj. 不可弯曲的, 僵硬的
例句：This approach is too inflexible and too costly.
这个方法太死板，而且花费也太高。

lotus
音标：英 /'ləʊtəs/  美 /'lotəs/
n. [植] 莲(花)
adj. 贪图安乐的
短语：lotus root — 莲藕
短语：lotus leaf — 荷莲叶
短语：lotus flower — 荷花，莲花
短语：lotus seed — 莲子，莲芯
短语：lotus pond — 荷花池，荷塘；莲花池
短语：lotus root starch — 藕粉
短语：blue lotus — 蓝莲花
短语：the golden lotus — <<金瓶梅>>（中国古典小说）
例句：The soul unfolds itself, like a lotus of countless petals.
灵魂伸展绽放，就像一朵有无数花瓣的莲花。
例句：For me, the lotus and blue cedar dominate, but they work well together.
她的芬香以莲花和蓝色雪松为主，几种香味完美融合。

inexplicable
音标：英 /,ɪnɪk'splɪkəb(ə)l; ,ɪnek-; ɪn'eksplɪ-/  美 /,ɪnɪk'splɪkəbl/
adj. 无法解释的，难理解的
例句：inexplicable behaviour
费解的行为
例句：For some inexplicable reason, he felt depressed.
他无端地感到很沮丧。

nineteen
音标：英 /naɪn'tiːn; 'naɪntiːn/  美 /,naɪn'tin/
num. 十九
例句：It was nineteen minutes past seven.
当时是7点19分。
例句：I was only nineteen (= 19 years old ).
我当时只有19岁。

therapeutic
音标：英 /,θerə'pjuːtɪk/  美 /,θɛrə'pjutɪk/
adj. 治疗的, 治疗学的 n治疗剂, 治疗学家
短语：therapeutic action — 治疗作用
短语：therapeutic massage — 保健按摩
短语：therapeutic index — 治疗指数，治疗指标
短语：therapeutic outcome — 治疗结果
例句：Some claim that the herb has therapeutic value for treating pain.
有些人称这种草药具有止痛的疗效。

restrictive
音标：英 /rɪ'strɪktɪv/  美 /rɪ'strɪktɪv/
adj. 限制性的
短语：restrictive condition — 限制条件
例句：Many members thought the rules were too restrictive.
很多会员认为这些规定限制条件太多。
例句：a restrictive policy on admission to the college
大学入学的限制性政策

ail
音标：英 /eɪl/  美 /el/
v. 生病，使苦恼
例句：A full-scale debate is under way on what ails the industry.
就困扰工业发展的弊端所展开的一次全面讨论正在进行中。

unbind
音标：英 /ʌn'baɪnd/  美 /,ʌn'baind/
v. 解开, 解放
例句：She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
她解开头绳，让头发在风里自由地飘。

Grecian
音标：英 /'ɡri:ʃən/  美 /'ɡriʃən/
adj. 希腊的, 希腊式的 n希腊学家
例句：a Grecian urn
希腊古瓮

defender
音标：英 /dɪ'fendə(r)/  美 /dɪ'fɛndɚ/
n. 防卫者, 拥护者
短语：defender of the faith — 卫护信仰者；信仰护卫者
短语：public defender — 公设辩护律师
例句：He presented himself as a defender of democracy.
他以民主捍卫者的姿态出现。

volcanism
音标：英 /'vɒlkənɪz(ə)m/  美 /'vɑlkənɪzm/
n. 火山作用
例句：His study of eruptions over the past 300 years with Ben Mason of the University of Cambridge and colleagues reveals that volcanism varies with the seasons.
他和剑桥大学的本.梅森及其同事研究了过去300年来发生的火山喷发，研究显示火山活动随季节变化而不同。
例句：Both kinds of plate boundary are associated with fault systems, earthquakes and volcanism, but the kinds of geologic activity observed at the two boundaries are quite different.
两种板块边界均与地层系统、地震以及火山活动有关，但在两种边界处观察到的诸般地质活动 却迥然不同。

subduction
音标：英 /səb'dʌkʃ(ə)n/  美 /səb'dʌkʃən/
n. [地]潜没(指地壳的板块沉到另一板块之下)
短语：subduction zone — 俯冲带；隐没带；消减带
例句：In the past 300 years, no earthquake nearly that large — nothing larger than magnitude-eight — had struck in the Japan subduction zone.
在过去的300年里，在日本俯冲地区，从没发生过一个如此巨大的地震-没有一次比八级还大。

diverge
音标：英 /daɪ'vɜːdʒ; dɪ-/  美 /daɪ'vɝdʒ/
v. 分歧
短语：diverge from — 背道而驰；背离
例句：The two species diverged millions of years ago.
这两个物种从数百万年前开始朝不同方向演变。
例句：Global growth rates are diverging markedly.
世界各地的增长率在发生明显的分化。

electrocardiogram
音标：英 /ɪ,lektrəʊ'kɑːdɪəgræm/  美 /ɪ,lɛktro'kɑrdɪoɡræm/
n. [医]心电图
例句：A disposable electrocardiogram machine the size of a Band-Aid monitors a heart patient.
一个邦迪大小的一次性心电图仪器监视着一个心脏病人。
例句：Some countries, such as Italy and Japan, screen young people with the use of an electrocardiogram (ECG, or EKG), which records the electrical signals present in the heart.
一些其他的国家，比如意大利和日本，人们用心电图（ECG或EKG）给年轻人做检查，心电图记录了心脏发出的电信号。

grope
音标：英 /grəʊp/  美 /ɡrop/
v. / n摸索
短语：grope for — v. 探索
例句：With his left hand he groped for the knob, turned it, and pulled the door open.
他用左手摸索到门把手，转动把手，把门拉开。

hesitate
音标：英 /'hezɪteɪt/  美 /'hɛzɪtet/
v. 犹豫, 踌躇
短语：don't hesitate — 别再犹豫了
短语：hesitate in — 吞吞吐吐
例句：Some parents hesitate to take these steps because they suspect that their child is exaggerating.
一些家长迟迟不肯采取这些措施，因为他们怀疑自己的孩子在夸大其词。

electroencephalogram
音标：英 /ɪ,lektrəʊɪn'sef(ə)ləgræm; -'kef-/
n. [医]脑电图
例句：The brain, too, sends out brain waves of electricity, which can be recorded in an electroencephalogram.
大脑也是一样，会发出脑电波，而脑电波可以在脑电图中记录。
例句：The researchers tracked various bits of data about a dreamer, like rapid eye movement electroencephalogram (EEG) readings. They then fed this data into the robot.
研究人员跟踪有关睡梦者的各种数据位，如快速眼动脑电图描记器读数，然后把这些数据输入机器人。
例句：He found that the number of pulses, known as sleep spindles, generated by this organ and measured by an electroencephalogram, which records electrical activity in the brain, varied among the sleepers.
他通过一种用于记录大脑电活动的脑电图设备测量了丘脑产生的脑电脉冲； 并且他发现，这个器官产生的脑电脉冲——也被称为睡眠纺锤波——的数量在不同志愿者身上存在差异。

blackout
音标：英 /'blækaʊt/  美 /'blækaʊt/
n. 灯火管制，断电
例句：...blackout curtains.
…灯火管制时用的窗帘。

jolt
音标：英 /dʒəʊlt; dʒɒlt/  美 /dʒolt/
v& n. (使)颠簸；震动
例句：We jolted along rough wet roads through an endless banana plantation.
我们沿崎岖潮湿的公路颠簸着驶过无边无际的香蕉种植园。
